title: MLH Fellowship — Fall 2026 Cohort
description: A fully remote, 12-week internship alternative where student developers collaborate on real open-source projects from major tech companies under expert mentorship. Includes an educational stipend.

title: Hacktoberfest 2026
description: The global month-long open-source celebration. Submit quality pull requests to public repositories tagged 'hacktoberfest' and earn digital badges and rewards. Open to all skill levels.

title: Smart India Hackathon 2026
organization: Ministry of Education's Innovation Cell · AICTE · Government of India
description: India's flagship nationwide hackathon. Solve real-world challenges from ministries, PSUs and industries. Colleges conduct internal campus hackathons to nominate teams to the national portal.

title: GSSoC 2026 — Open Source & AI Builders Program
description: One of the world's largest free open-source and AI builder programs. Contribute to open source or build AI agents (Agents for India track) with cash prizes up to ₹50,000, swags and certificates.
